sales_notes: The customer wants to consolidate customer reporting across business units.
During the discovery call, the customer requested Salesforce integration.
The customer also asked whether five years of historical data could be migrated.
Sales suggested implementation might be possible within six weeks, but no delivery timeline was agreed.
The VP of Operations, Sarah Mitchell, was identified as the executive sponsor.
The technical implementation owner has not yet been identified.
The customer asked for executive dashboards. The exact dashboard scope remains undefined.
